messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: gateway-ingress | elevated 5xx/timeouts across EU region. Severity: P1. Symptoms: sustained 502/504 + timeouts; 5xx rate ~12% over 5m. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/gateway-5xx

alex: ack — I'm oncall. Starting timeline and collecting logs. Paging @sarah for infra help. Posting correlation ids as we find them.

sarah: on my way. grabbing kv logs and egress traces now. Do we have customer impact list?

mike: support just surfaced 3 customer reports (IDs redwood-413, redwood-418) — timeouts around 2026-03-15T16:34Z. Correlation id from one report: corr=0x7f1a9c.

alex: thanks. metrics dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dashboards/gateway-5xx?region=eu — see spike at ~16:29-16:36Z.

sarah: looking at kv/logs: a lot of upstream retries to embeddings-svc and model-proxy. Many upstream responses 429 then gateway retries -> 502s. Hypothesis: upstream rate limiting amplified by gateway retry policy.

alex: hypothesis noted. Can someone fetch full trace for corr=0x7f1a9c? Use `logs fetch --corr 0x7f1a9c` or Trace UI: https://logs.redwood.internal/trace/0x7f1a9c

opsbot: Log bundle generated: https://logs.redwood.internal/bundles/2245678901 (contains kv logs, ingress proxy traces, egress to embeddings-svc).

sarah: pulled bundle. Snippet from ingress proxy at 16:35:12Z:
```
IN: request id=corr=0x7f1a9c route=/api/v1/generate upstream=embeddings-svc attempts=4 last_status=429
OUT: gateway retry backoff applied -> eventually upstream returned 504
```

sarah: also seeing concurrent connection spike to embeddings-svc ~2.3x baseline starting 16:30Z.

alex: ok. Hypothesis 1: embeddings-svc hitting internal throttles -> upstream 429 -> gateway configured with aggressive retry ladder -> retry amplification causes queueing/timeouts -> 502/504s for callers.

mike: that aligns with support reports. CS says some sessions timed out but later succeeded after a retry (intermittent).

alex: mitigation plan (live): 1) temporarily reduce gateway retry count to 1 for the EU ingress rule, 2) enable route fallback to cached-model-pool for non-critical calls, 3) notify embeddings team to look at throttles. Applying first two now.

sarah: reducing retry_count from 4 -> 1 on gateway ingress (policy id gw-eu-retry) — applied at 16:36:45Z. Confirming config: `retry_count=1 backoff=200ms`.

opsbot: config change recorded: /configs/gateway/gw-eu-retry v23 -> v24 by sarah.

sarah: enabling fallback route to cached-model-pool (read-only) for /api/v1/embeds non-critical flags — applied 16:37:10Z.

alex: monitoring metrics now. 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 5% within 2m. Latency p95 improving. Good sign.

mike: CS update: customer redwood-413 reports fewer errors after 16:40Z.

alex: timeline so far:
- 16:29Z: ingress 5xx metric uptick begins
- 16:34Z: first customer report (redwood-413) corr=0x7f1a9c
- 16:35Z: upstream 429 spikes observed against embeddings-svc
- 16:36:45Z: reduced gateway retry_count -> 1 (sarah)
- 16:37:10Z: enabled route fallback to cached-model-pool (sarah)
- 16:40Z: 5xx rate down to ~5% and customer reports tapering

jenn: confirming we should open an RCA with model/embeddings team. I'll own postmortem doc. tagging hypothesis: retry amplification due to upstream throttling + gateway retry config.

mike: adding customer impact notes to incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-2245678901 — moderate impact for EU customers, CS notified, mitigation applied.

alex: next steps before handoff: collect full traces for top 10 correlation ids, export kv log slices 16:25-16:45Z, and collect embeddings-svc throttle metrics. assign owners?

sarah: I'll collect kv slices and throttle metrics (owner: sarah).

jenn: I'll assemble timeline + customer impact + open RCA ticket (owner: jenn).

mike: I'll follow up with CS for any late customer reports (owner: mike).

incident-bot: Reminder: runbook step — notify platform security/exec if customer PII impacted. No evidence of PII exposure so far.

alex: handing oncall to @taylor at 17:00Z — taylor will monitor recovery and drive postmortem next day with jenn and sarah.

taylor: taking over. I'll verify long-tail errors after 17:00Z and validate rollback plan for retry policy if needed.

alex: closing live mitigation. We'll keep this thread for logs/timeline and move to postmortem doc: https://pm.redwood.internal/rca/2245678901. Good work everyone :thumbsup:
